headline: Fair Isaac (FICO) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Cut As Analysts Split On Outlook
summary: Fair Isaac is in focus after analysts adjusted their price targets into a wide band around US$1,250 to US$1,639, alongside fair value estimates moving from US$1,552.52 to US$1,512.25. These shifts reflect a split narrative, with bullish views tied to software execution and earnings delivery, and more cautious voices highlighting mortgage credit trends, valuation, and regulatory timing for key programs. As you read on, you will see how this evolving analyst debate may shape your view of Fair...
